blogs.title: Admitting the Past: The 'Battle' Test for Intrinsic Firearm Evidence
blogs.description: This post analyzes the Eighth Circuit's strict adherence to *United States v. Battle* regarding Rule 404(b) objections. It explores the distinction between improper propensity evidence and 'intrinsic' evidence used to prove continuous possession of a specific weapon, and why witness testimony about prior gun sightings was deemed indispensable for a felon-in-possession conviction.

blogs.title: Guideline Triaging: The Intersection of ACCA and USSG § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B)
blogs.description: A technical examination of the district court's sentencing calculation under the post-*Booker* advisory guidelines regime. The post focuses on how the Eighth Circuit applies the 'greater offense level' rule when a defendant has prior violent felonies (ACCAs) alongside the specific 'possession in connection with another felony' enhancement, ensuring the Guidelines range accurately reflects statutory findings.

blogs.title: The Duty of Briefing: Limited Discretion When Defense Counsel Offers No Authority
blogs.description: An examination of the appellate court's response to the defendants' failure to provide legal support for their evidentiary claims. This post discusses the shifting burden on defense counsel during appeal, the limits of 'harmless error' review, and the judicial tendency to reject 'no-case' arguments that lack substantive analysis or citation.
